original_hypothesis: A single all-fields gate across internal technical projection and external field truth simplifies acceptance and does not block technically scope-limited review. This was an author model assumption, NOT a claim about original Product implementation.

considered_alternatives.approach: Separate technically observable fields from independently attested field truth, rights, and exact source-version authority

decision_rationale: A narrow technical observation may be reviewed with exact bounded fields; requiring all external professional facts too early creates an unreviewable false dependency. Independent real-world truth and work rights remain mandatory for professional assertions. Historical knowledge cannot be promoted into current Product norms by file modification date.
